summary: The changed documentation accurately reflects the direct, thread-local dynamic-variable assignments.

items.issue: The parameter description says the stream is “returned by `out`”, but `out` is also the parameter name, making the accessor reference ambiguous.
items.suggestion: Use “the output stream assigned to the current thread” (or link explicitly to `[[out]]`).

items.issue: The parameter description ambiguously refers to `err`, which is also the parameter name.
items.suggestion: Use “the error stream assigned to the current thread” (or link explicitly to `[[err]]`).

items.issue: The parameter description ambiguously refers to `in`, which is also the parameter name.
items.suggestion: Use “the input reader assigned to the current thread” (or link explicitly to `[[in]]`).
